data.one_liner: A BLoC implementation that uses async generators to emit state streams.
data.what_it_does: It provides a StreamBloc class that converts events into streams of states using mapEventToStates. The API is compatible with the official bloc package and can be used with flutter_bloc widgets. It also offers a BlocLifecycleMixin for stream-based Bloc-to-Bloc communication.
use_when: You want to keep compatibility with bloc 8.x
You want to use stream transformers on events
You prefer a single method to emit multiple states
avoid_when: You prefer the newer on() pattern of bloc 8.x
You rely heavily on freezed-generated union types
You need the latest bloc features not yet merged
strengths: Supports async generators for multiple state emissions
Provides lifecycle mixin for stream communication
weaknesses: May not support newest bloc features
Requires manual handling of identical states

alternatives.name: bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: Official, actively maintained, uses on() pattern and integrates with freezed
